component.name: PhoneToLinux Desktop
component.summary: Connect your Android phone to Linux

description.p: PhoneToLinux Desktop is a modern Avalonia UI application for Linux that seamlessly integrates your computer with your Android smartphone.

ul.li: Make and receive voice calls directly from your desktop.
Send and receive SMS/MMS messages with real-time conversation synchronization.
Sync contacts and browse your phone storage securely via WebDAV.
Receive native Linux desktop notifications for calls and messages.

description.p: Fixed RPM transaction failure by filtering out multi-platform native runtimes during packaging, and fully transitioned to .NET 10 runtime.
Added dynamic contact search and keyboard autocomplete in the contacts view, and Fedora AppStream metainfo integration for software centers.
Current stable release featuring enhanced D-Bus security, instant IP auto-discovery, dynamic Roslyn plugin engine, and improved UI navigation.
Added storage browser, secure pairing enhancements, and improved SMS real-time streaming.
